items.title: Jerry Jerome interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: George Simon came up with Glenn Miller and introduced me to Glenn.

ctx.x: No matter how hard times are people will still need entertainment.

Yeah. Manage to do something like that just to assuage their problems you know. But I was with Harry until we got to New York and we were playing the Raymour Ballroom. And George Simon came up with Glenn Miller and introduced me to Glenn. I didn’t know who Glenn was, never heard of him. You know he was a sideman then, as a matter of fact he was playing with Ray Noble and doing theater dates or radio commercials or whatever, recordings. And oh, George Simon had given me an A minus rating in the band, myself, he…
You mean in print he had done this?
